title: Dreamer earns respect, then falls for Sandman’s trap
summary: Tommy Dreamer wins the hostile crowd’s respect by enduring the Sandman’s punishment. His later guilt over an apparent injury makes him vulnerable to a carefully staged deception.

chapters.title: Dreamer takes the caning
chapters.result: Sandman wins the Singapore Cane match by disqualification.
chapters.context: Dreamer accepts the punishment and asks for more, changing his relationship with the crowd.

chapters.title: The apparent blinding
chapters.result: Dreamer wins the I Quit match after the cigarette injury angle.
chapters.context: Sandman’s supposed blindness is part of the story, leaving Dreamer remorseful.

chapters.title: The retirement ceremony is a setup
chapters.result: Sandman removes his bandages and attacks Dreamer.
chapters.context: The apparent retirement exposes the blindness as a ruse arranged with Woman.
